preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 1 and 30,000.
There must be exactly 4n replication rules.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n for a, b, c in rules)
preconditions.description: Each rule must specify valid server indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to apply the rules, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by a permutation of 4n rule numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(rule) <= 4 * n for rule in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output sequence must contain each rule number from 1 to 4n exactly once.
At no time should any server have more than 9 processes.
